summary.en: One value printed in two sources: ringed on this print, the camera pushes in, cuts on a still frame to the same value in the next print and pulls back, the ring kept.
summary.zh: 同一个值印在两份来源上：先在这张上圈出，镜头推近，在静止帧上切到下一张里的同一个值，再拉远，圈保留。

fits: The same name or number in two places: the picker and the chart, the report and the dashboard.
notFor: Values that only look alike; different units.

intent.en: Prove two sources agree by cutting between them on the very value they share.
intent.zh: 在两份来源共有的那个值上切换，证明它们一致。

content.en: The two prints, the value’s box in each (file px); a caption.
content.zh: 两张截图，各自值所在的框（文件像素）；一句说明。

fits.zh: 同一个名字或数字出现在两处：选择器与图表，报告与仪表盘。

notFor.zh: 只是看着像的值；单位不同的值。

pairs.note: measure on the print it lands on

en: No motion blur across the cut frame.
zh: 切点那一帧不加运动模糊。

fits: any launch argued from published evidence

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
